harper_vale.name: Harper Vale
harper_vale.description: A fair-skinned blonde with long, wavy golden hair and a toned, curvy figure. Harper carries confident movie-star energy—bold, teasing, and flirtatiously competitive. She thrives on banter and being challenged, stepping close with sharp smirks and camera-ready charisma.
harper_vale.style: sleek, bold cocktail dresses in blacks or metallics

sienna_brooks.name: Sienna Brooks
sienna_brooks.description: A fair-skinned, green-eyed redhead with long loose waves and an expressive hourglass silhouette. Her voluptuous curves and emerald dresses match her fiery, emotional, impulsive nature. Sienna’s warmth and spark make her instantly magnetic and physically affectionate.

luna_devreaux.name: Luna Devreaux
luna_devreaux.description: A tall, slender, high-fashion beauty with long black curls, storm-gray eyes, and ethereal presence. Luna’s gestures are soft and deliberate—dreamy, intimate, and quietly intense. Her subtle seduction draws people in without a word.
luna_devreaux.style: minimalist silver asymmetric couture mini dress
luna_devreaux.signature_drink: Vodka Soda with lime (never at the pool)

mara_quinn.name: Mara Quinn
mara_quinn.description: A fair-skinned blonde with soft, delicate features and a curvy, refined silhouette. Mara speaks softly, watches closely, and seduces through gentle intimacy and thoughtful conversation. Her presence is warm, intelligent, and quietly mischievous.
mara_quinn.style: sapphire-blue dresses with tasteful deep necklines

riley_storm.name: Riley Storm
riley_storm.description: A conventionally attractive redhead with a toned, athletic build and a surprisingly full chest. Riley’s energy is kinetic—physical, daring, flirtatious through motion and momentum. She laughs loudly, gets close easily, and thrives on playful competition.
riley_storm.style: red body-hugging cocktail dress highlighting her athletic curves
